proposals.evidence: Full candra section 2 gives Bshk čən, Chilisso čan, Lahnda cann/can, regional cand/cā̃d/cān and Assamese sā̃d/sān, alongside Gujarati cā̃do. These support the selected affricate/sibilant moon forms with source velar versus dental nasal spelling, retroflexion, vowel nasalization and ordinary endings preserved. Both can/cand alternatives fit. Local sound history and cross-IA transmission are qualified; extra syllables and moonlight-derived responses are excluded. Exact response: tsand.
